$note: Documentation layout config. Hue-neutral, mode-independent. These values are for the design system presentation layer — not the client's product. Client component colors showcase against these neutral frames. All color values are direct hex (not semantic aliases) to decouple documentation from light/dark mode.
$default-mode-note: Documentation layer mode — independent of standards.json default-mode (client product). Light frames use light mode components. Change to dark if delivering dark-themed documentation.

frame.$note: Each section is an independent frame on the canvas. Frames are spaced by frame-group-gap.

surface.$note: Elevation levels for nesting within frames. Surface-1 for card-like containers, surface-2 for recessed areas.

dark.$note: Dark documentation variant — neutral dark stage for reviewing dark-mode components (the product's actual theme, when default-mode is dark). Mirrors the light frame's elevation relationships. The top-level frame/surface/outline above remain the light variant (Figma reads those).

spacing.$note: Nesting hierarchy: frame-group-gap (between frames on canvas) > section-gap (between sections within a frame) > component-group-gap (between groups of related components) > component-gap (between individual components in a row) > label-gap (between a label and its content) > description-gap (between title and description text).
